finding.comment: 'No manual approval exists' is directly contradicted by the Production section; the document cannot tell the reader which behavior is real.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/deployment.md
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+# Deployment
+
+Every merged commit is deployed to production automatically. No
+manual approval exists anywhere in the pipeline.
+
+## Production
+
+Production deploys require approval from the release team before
+they proceed.

rationale: genuine contradiction between universal claim and exception section
